name: Incline Push-Up
description: A step between wall and floor push-ups: hands on a bench or sturdy table, body straight, lower your chest to the edge and press away.

source.note: Standard exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Put your hands on the edge of a sturdy bench, just wider than your shoulders.
Walk your feet back until your body is a straight line.
cues: Keep your body in one line from head to heels.
Elbows angle back, not straight out.
Lower your chest toward the edge, then press away.

prescription.note: Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Arms straight
keyframes.cue: Hands on the bench, body straight.

keyframes.name: Lower
keyframes.cue: Bend your elbows and lower your chest.
